This contribution reveals one issue in release independence specifications which causes unnecessary maintenance when new release in created and this is also many times forgotten when new version of specs are released making them wrong. Both LTE and NR specs have similar statement which references to a particular release. This referred release is the same release as the specs are, hence, once new release of specs is created these references needs to be changed but it is not MCCs task therefore a CR would be needed. Specification rapporteurs could provide this CR. As an example, captures from some releases of 36.101 are shown below. Yellow highlighted are correct but REL-18 reference is not updated and needs a correction. REL-8 Requirements for a Rel-8 UE for additional E-UTRA operating band
